This model delivers a distraction-free environment for focusing on books. Join the many bibliophiles who trust the Xteink brand for quality builds.

Our team provides a premium experience for every loyal user. The sleek design of this unit sets a new standard for modern fans of digital books.

Whether traveling or relaxing at home, the e reader technology inside this unit provides clarity and speed in every page turn you make.

With its durable finish and smart features, this portable device is the definitive choice for the modern digital book lover who wants quality.

Keep your Xteink X3 protected with this lightweight magnetic case. Designed for a precise fit, it attaches securely to the back of the device, providing everyday protection without adding bulk.

products.title: eReader Magnetic Reading Light
products.body_html:
Light up your reading, anywhere.

Please use this without a case; otherwise, the magnetic strength may not be sufficient.

The Xteink Magnetic Reading Light is a versatile, rechargeable reading lamp designed for effortless night reading.

With its magnetic back and clip-on design, it attaches securely to your Xteink X3 or X4, or clips directly onto a book, providing comfortable illumination wherever you read.

products.title: eReader Adhesive Metal Ring
products.body_html:
Attach your reading, anywhere.

The Xteink eReader Magnetic Stick-On Ring is designed to expand how and where you use your Xteink eReader.

Featuring an adhesive backing on one side and a built-in magnet on the other, it allows your device to attach securely to a variety of surfaces, making everyday use more flexible and convenient.

Whether at your desk, by your phone, bedside, or on the go, it helps keep your reading within easy reach.

products.title: X3 Matte Screen Protector
products.body_html:
Designed for Paper-Like Reading and Daily Protection

The Xteink X3 Matte Screen Protector is tailored specifically for the X3, ensuring a precise fit that aligns with the device’s compact, minimalist design.

Made from high-quality PET material, it minimizes glare and reflections, delivering a softer, paper-like reading experience that remains comfortable on the eyes, even during longer sessions or in bright environments.

It also provides reliable protection against scratches, dust, and everyday wear, helping maintain a clean display while preserving a natural reading feel.

Each pack includes 2 screen protectors.

products.title: X3 Tempered Glass Screen Protector
products.body_html:
Designed for Clarity and Everyday Protection

The Xteink X3 Clear Screen Protector is designed specifically for the X3, ensuring a precise fit that maintains the device’s compact, minimalist design.

Made from durable tempered glass, it preserves screen clarity while protecting against scratches, dust, and fingerprints, keeping your display clean and sharp during daily use.

It maintains the original look and feel of the screen, without affecting readability or touch response.

Each pack includes 1 screen protector.

products.title: X3 Protective Case
products.body_html:
Light protection with a smooth matte look

This soft shell case provides everyday protection while maintaining the device's slim profile.

The Xteink X3 Protective Case is designed specifically for the X3. Made from lightweight polycarbonate material, it provides everyday protection while maintaining the slim profile of the device.

Featuring a matte look with a smooth surface, the case delivers a soft, understated appearance without a rough or textured feel. It stays comfortable in the hand while keeping a clean, low-gloss finish.

Weighing just 14g, it fits closely to the X3 body without adding bulk.
